senses.gloss_en: to spy on; to eye covetously; to snoop around

examples.en: Motorbikes encroach on the car lane.

senses.gloss_en: to jostle; to push in order to squeeze in

examples.vi: Mọi người lấn nhau để vào cửa trước.
examples.en: Everyone jostled each other to get in through the door first.

notes: Sense 2 (Southern, jostle) could not be verified; example constructed.

examples.vi: Nhà tôi dùng cửa sổ kính kép để cách âm.

senses.gloss_en: male singer in chèo (traditional Vietnamese opera)

senses.gloss_en: to expect; to place one's hopes in

notes: Sense 2 (wiktionary pos verb, 'to alarm') rewritten as noun, since its example uses it as a noun.
